title: Point B v2 publication-evidence summary
note: All numbers verified from full-data runs. No claim that Point B improves G3 global AUC/F1 (Point A G3 AUC=0.875983, F1=0.516921 unchanged).

attention_separation.interpretation: robustly positive across seeds; attention concentrates on abnormal users

uniform_baseline_mean_iou.note: degenerate predict-all: recall=1, constant IoU floor

random_interval_mean_iou.note: FAIR baseline: random contiguous interval, length = true anomaly length, random position; no recall floor

mil_vs_random_interval.verdict: tie_at_median; MIL higher on MEAN (0.159 vs 0.113) -> headline fair comparison
mil_vs_random_interval.interpretation: Against the fair random-interval baseline (no recall floor), MIL wins on mean IoU by ~41% but ties at the per-user median due to MIL's bimodal hit-or-miss distribution.

mil_vs_uniform.note: uniform is degenerate; reported for completeness only

headline: Against a FAIR random-interval baseline (no degenerate recall floor), MIL localization achieves mean IoU 0.159 (95% CI [0.111, 0.207]) vs 0.113, a ~41% relative gain, and attention separation is robustly positive (0.198 +/- 0.020 across 5 seeds). Per-user MEDIAN IoU is a statistical tie (Wilcoxon p<1e-12, median_diff=0) because MIL is bimodal: it localizes abrupt/zero anomalies precisely (zero-shape IoU 0.302) but does not localize gradual morphologies (slow_drift 0.108).
honest_caveat_iou_distribution: MIL per-user IoU is bimodal (precise hit OR complete miss=0). On MEAN IoU and pa-F1 and attention-separation MIL beats all baselines including the fair random-interval baseline (0.159 vs 0.113). At the per-user MEDIAN, MIL ties the fair baseline (median_diff=0) and is below the degenerate predict-all uniform baseline (which trivially gets recall=1 and a constant IoU floor ~|gt|/34 on sparse anomalies). Conclusion: MIL provides precise localization for a substantial subset (esp. drop-to-zero) and wins on every mean-level metric vs the fair baseline, but its hit-or-miss nature means the median user is not localized better than random. This is disclosed, not hidden.

weak_shape_boundary.gate: sudden_drop AND slow_drift must exceed uniform without regressing zero/sustained_low
weak_shape_boundary.gate_result: NOT MET (slow_drift 0.109 < uniform 0.117); tuning stopped per pre-commitment
weak_shape_boundary.documented_scope: Validated for drop-to-zero (zero IoU ~0.30, ~2.5x uniform) and sudden-drop morphology; sustained-low marginal; gradual slow-drift NOT reliably localized.

ab_complementarity.narrative: Point A (G3 ensemble) answers WHO is anomalous; Point B v2 answers WHEN (which months) and WHAT morphology. ~50% of G3-positive users receive a confident contiguous B interval, frequently in late months.
